outcome: histopathological changes in placenta (maternal vascular malperfusion, villous infarct, villous agglutination, intervillous and perivillous fibrin deposits, fetal vascular malperfusion, avascular villi, stem vessel obliteration)
cohort: The study included twenty-five placentas from mothers who were positive for COVID-19.
finding: Placentas from COVID-19 positive mothers exhibited features of maternal and fetal vascular malperfusion, with 21 out of 25 pregnancies resulting in live births with normal birth weight and 4 in spontaneous abortions.
gest_age: 14-22 weeks (for spontaneous abortions), gestational age was collected for all pregnancies.
